svg.title: An exactly representable three-mode spectral baseline
svg.desc: Original least-squares fit of three independent heat attenuation gains at fixed diffusivity0.1 and time0.1. The shown128-cell prediction reuses a fit from64-cell samples. Roundoff-level error is expected for this deliberately matched linear finite-mode family; this is not G-FuNK.
